title: Malaysia Study Visa Pakistan — Requirements, Fees, IELTS & FAQ | SK Immigration
description: Malaysia study visa from Pakistan (Asia): requirements, documents, fees, IELTS, low marks, timeline and FAQ. SK Immigration Services, Rawalpindi.

faqs.question: What are Malaysia study visa requirements from Pakistan?
faqs.answer: Offer from a recognized Malaysian institution; EMGS / student pass documentation; Passport validity; Academic documents. SK Immigration builds a full checklist for your case.

faqs.question: How much does it cost to study in Malaysia from Pakistan?
faqs.answer: Budget tuition + living + visa/insurance. Malaysia is generally more affordable than UK/Canada for many programmes. SK packages from PKR 50,000 cover preparation only — not tuition.

faqs.question: Do I need IELTS for Malaysia study visa?
faqs.answer: Many programmes need IELTS or MUET/university English; some accept MOI.

faqs.question: Can I study in Malaysia with low marks?
faqs.answer: Foundation pathways exist; we check recognition.

faqs.question: How long does Malaysia student visa take from Pakistan?
faqs.answer: Often 1–3 months after complete EMGS file.

faqs.question: What documents are needed for Malaysia student visa?
faqs.answer: Passport; Offer letter; Academics; Photos; Medical reports; Payment proofs.

faqs.question: Can I work while studying in Malaysia?
faqs.answer: Student pass work rights are limited — follow official rules only.

faqs.question: How to apply for Malaysia study visa from Pakistan?
faqs.answer: Secure admission, prepare funds/insurance/docs, then file the correct national/student visa. SK Immigration sequences the file; authorities decide.

faqs.question: What is SK Immigration’s fee for Malaysia study?
faqs.answer: Student packages from PKR 50,000 for preparation. Embassy and university fees are separate. No visa guarantees.

faqs.question: Do you guarantee Malaysia student visa approval?
faqs.answer: No. Embassies and immigration authorities decide. We prepare complete, honest files.
